title: Root→audit-trail handoff record (prd-autofix)
description: Single JSONL record appended to .scratch/handoff.jsonl by root after applying an autofix-tagged finding to docs/prd.md. The record exists so (a) product-requirements-expert can audit the trail on its next dispatch, (b) handoff.py audit-autofix (the code-quality-gate skill's autofix audit) can statically re-validate the change against the autofix allowlist. It keeps a doc-only PRD fix in the current review round: without it, the only resolution path is a fresh prd-entry, which re-enters the pipeline at design triage.

author.description: Pinned to root. Only root may apply autofixes on docs/prd.md; specialist agents (product-requirements-expert excepted) never write to that file.

file.description: The one autofix-eligible PRD path, pinned. A design-doc fix uses the design-doc-autofix record instead.

category.description: Which autofix category the source finding falls under. The allowlist is the closed enum below — any other category is not autofix-eligible on docs/prd.md and must route to product-requirements-expert.

source_finding.description: Copy of the doc-reviewer finding that authorised this autofix. Self-contained so the audit trail does not depend on resolving back-references into review-feedback records.

fix.description: The literal replacement string the doc-reviewer proposed. Root applies this verbatim via Edit; it does not paraphrase or improve the fix.

old_content.description: Literal pre-edit string (the Edit tool's old_string). Used by the linter to re-derive the diff for static validation.

new_content.description: Literal post-edit string (the Edit tool's new_string). Must equal source_finding.fix byte-for-byte — root applies the doc-reviewer's fix verbatim.

lines_changed.description: Count of lines changed by this autofix. Capped at 5 by the autofix allowlist — anything larger is not autofix-eligible.

chars_changed.description: Count of characters changed by this autofix. Capped at 200 — anything larger is not autofix-eligible.
